verdict.rationale: Auth0's B2B page says enterprise clients can synchronize user directories via SCIM, and the pricing page lists SCIM as a new enterprise-connection feature. That confirms a first-party SCIM inbound provisioning capability. The evidence is marketing-level only and does not show group sync or that deprovisioning in the IdP revokes app access. Missing for 10: group sync evidence, documented deprovisioning/access-revocation behavior, in-depth SCIM docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
